subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Interagir em situações de intercâmbio oral para realizar as atividades em sala de aula, de forma respeitosa e colaborativa, trocando ideias e engajando-se em brincadeiras e jogos.

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras acordadas para tomar a palavra respeitosamente durante discussões
components.description_en: Apply agreed-upon rules for gaining the floor respectfully during discussions
components.cc_component_description: Apply agreed-upon rules for gaining the floor respectfully during discussions

components.description_pt: Engajar-se colaborativamente em jogos e brincadeiras usando inglês falado
components.description_en: Engage collaboratively in games and play using spoken English

components.description_pt: Usar linguagem apropriada para interagir com colegas durante trocas em sala de aula
components.description_en: Use appropriate language to interact with peers during classroom exchanges
components.cc_component_description: Build on others' talk by linking comments to the remarks of peers during discussion

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., gaining the floor in respectful ways, listening to others with care, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).
Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about grade 2 topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.
